children: Manjunath GM takes on a wider mandate covering leadership hiring and strategic recruitment after two decades in talent acquisition
Hexaware Technologies has elevated Manjunath GM to Vice President, Talent Acquisition, Leadership and Strategic Recruitment, expanding his mandate across leadership hiring and strategic recruitment.

Manjunath brings 25 years of overall professional experience, including 21 years in talent acquisition, with expertise spanning leadership hiring, recruitment strategy and talent development. At Hexaware, he has been associated with talent acquisition leadership and strategic hiring, supporting recruitment across technology and business functions.

In his expanded role, Manjunath will focus on strengthening leadership hiring and strategic talent acquisition, with an emphasis on building talent pipelines aligned with Hexaware’s evolving workforce requirements.

His appointment comes as Hexaware continues to expand its global workforce and hiring capabilities. The company has previously announced large-scale recruitment plans across India and international markets, reflecting the growing importance of talent acquisition in supporting its business expansion.
